classification: Demon; former member of the Twelve Kizuki; former Lower Rank Six
summary: A demon whose Blood Demon Art manipulates the rooms of his mansion through the drums on his body. He can alter gravity and room orientation, send claw-like air attacks, and teleport within the house; much of this toolkit depends on the mansion and his drums.

stats.durability: Varies by body part; at most Small Building level, likely higher when reinforced
stats.speed: Subsonic combat speed; Transonic attack speed for his claw attacks
stats.range: Several meters; tens of meters with teleportation

abilities: Demon physiology, including regeneration and enhanced senses
Possible fungus manipulation (noted mold smell before claw attacks)
Can reinforce parts of his body
equipment: Drums on his body; Blood Demon Art is tied to them and his mansion
weaknesses: Standard Demon weaknesses are listed on the profile.
His Blood Demon Art depends on his mansion.
The drums can fall off when he is injured and can be used by others; he is apparently unable to grow replacement drums.
evidence: The profile explicitly ties room manipulation and teleportation to his mansion and drums. Sunlight and Nichirin are standard Demon Slayer weaknesses, not direct elemental matchups; neither is assumed available to Adam. Ratings are qualitative conversions for this demo, not official VS Battles Wiki numbers.
